ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels comprise approximately 60% of the fluke surface, primarily on the lateral lobes, while low-intensity black pixels occupy the remaining 40%, concentrated in the central peduncle and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral contiguous high-intensity white fields are bifurcated by a central low-intensity black vertical axis. Extensive low-intensity 'staining' or mottling is distributed across both white fields, with higher density near the central notch and the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp, acute V-shaped depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 65 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude jagged peaks (macro-serrations) while the left lobe displays lower amplitude, high-frequency pixel variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into an upward-sloping sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels are localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, with isolated white circular spots visible within the dark central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the white surface of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the horizontal fluke axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe indicating tissue loss; extensive circular white scarring on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific pixel-density gradient at the transition between the dark central column and white lobes, appearing as a feathered or stippled pattern.
